transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?
I guess… I’ve just been feeling low for a long time. I still do my routes and my volunteer shifts, but most days it feels heavy, like I’m just going through the motions.
Have you noticed that you don’t enjoy things as much as you used to, or that activities you once looked forward to feel like a chore now?
I don’t know… maybe a little, but I can’t really say. I still do what I need to do. Things just feel kind of flat sometimes.
Have you noticed that you don’t take pleasure in things you used to enjoy, or that you’ve lost interest in activities you once looked forward to?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I still do some of the same things… I just don’t think about it that much. Nothing really stands out.
Over the past few weeks, have you found that you don’t get as much pleasure out of things as you used to, even when you’re doing something you used to enjoy?
I’m not sure. I mean… I still do the same stuff, but I don’t really pay attention to whether I’m enjoying it or not. It’s just kind of… there.
Do you find that you feel down or low most of the day, nearly every day?
Yeah… I guess so. Most days there’s just this heavy, low feeling there. I still get through my routes and my volunteer shifts, but it feels like I’m just going through the motions a lot of the time.
How long have you been feeling this way? Has this low mood been present most days for at least two weeks, or has it come and gone?
It’s been… a while. Not just a couple weeks. I’d say about three years, since my dad died. Most days, yeah.
